Jordan (Sales): FYI transferring Northstar Labs to CS — signed yesterday, Dedicated pool (4x A100 equiv), VPC peering requested, SSO + SCIM required. Contract: https://redwood/contracts/NORTHSTAR-2026. Renewal window: Feb 2026, noted churn risk if latency or data residency issues surface.
Maya (CS): Thanks. Can someone paste the initial onboarding checklist and owners? I'll kick off the onboarding schedule with the customer next week.
Jordan (Sales): Quick bullets: - Provision Dedicated (env: northstar-prod) - VPC peering & IP allowlist - SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning - Private key exchange for logs (KMS) - 90-day onboarding success metric: inference error rate <=1% and avg tail latency <180ms
Jordan (Sales): Also flagged that they may want local on-prem later; for now they're in AWS us-east-1. They want a canary rollout for the model and cost estimate for 100M tokens/mo.
Maya (CS): @Priya can you own the rollout plan & eng ticket? I'll own customer enablement and renewal play.
Priya (Platform Eng): I can take rollout. I'll open ENG-4921 for Dedicated provisioning + canary routing and attach the performance SLAs. Need the model name from Sales and expected seq lengths.
Jordan (Sales): Model is redwood/gpt-medium-oc-1. Typical prompt lengths 100-400 tokens, 95th seq ~350. I'll add those to the contract notes.
Sam (Support): I'll prepare runbook for incidents and add alert thresholds to pager. Recommend: >5% error rate 15m -> page; tail latency >500ms 5m -> page. Also will create a support alias: northstar-support@redwood.com.
Maya (CS): Good. Action owners: Maya - overall onboarding lead and renewal owner; Priya - ENG-4921 (Dedicated + canary rollout); Sam - support runbook + alias; Jordan - share final model/config and contract items.
Maya (CS): Immediate next steps I will take this afternoon: 1) Send intro email with onboarding timeline and required creds; 2) Schedule provisioning kickoff for Tue 10am ET; 3) Share enablement docs and 2-hour training slot for their SREs.
Priya (Platform Eng): Notes for ENG-4921: need cloud account IDs, VPC CIDRs, peering contact, expected throughput (rps) for canary, and KMS key ARN if they want CMK.
Jordan (Sales): I'll DM the account owner's cloud IDs and KMS contact to Priya now.
handoff-bot: handoff checklist created: [Provisioning requested, Security review queued, Support alias created (pending), Training scheduled (pending)].
Maya (CS): Risk note: they mentioned an internal procurement review tied to renewal; if onboarding slips >30 days it's likely to surface. I'll track weekly and flag any blockers.
Sam (Support): I'll add a private Slack channel #northstar-ops for post-onboarding alerts and runbook references and invite the oncall rotation.
Maya (CS): Perfect. I'll update the shared handoff doc and tag owners. Leaving this thread open for any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
